_comment: 'The WINNER creates a <X> token' was authored as a CLASH followed by an UNCONDITIONAL CREATE_TOKEN, so the controller got the token whether they won the clash or lost it -- the clash decided nothing. CLASH already takes on_winner outcome specs; the token now rides one. The 'target' on the CLASH was unread and named the attacking hero, which is the default anyway; where it was a filter it read ATTACK_CLASS_IN classes=['hero'], and 'hero' is not a class.
